A scope binding authorizes no file. It only states, for records written before tools/ci/project_truth_ledger.py read commit scopes, which commits each record covers, as the record's own text declares them (see each 'basis').
It can only narrow: without it these non-reusable records cover nothing under the checker; with it they cover the listed commits and no later commit.
It may not bind a record that declares its own commit_scope or is reusable, and a second binding of the same record makes that record cover nothing (the checker refuses to choose).
The records it binds keep their own limits; this record widens none of their paths or authority.
